1. Click the "Login" button — the launcher will attempt to retrieve a verification code;\n
2. Enter the code provided by %s on the pop-up webpage and click "Allow access";\n

If the webpage shows an "Error" message or the account fails to be added, please retry the above steps.\n

Let\'s take a quick look at what the main screen can do.
Tap here to open the account manager, where you can add or manage your Minecraft accounts
Tap here to open the version list, where every game version you install will be listed
Not happy with where the action menu is?
Long-press the card to pick it up, then drag and drop it to dock on the other side
Don\'t worry! You can pin content here as cards and arrange it freely, as long as it provides the \"%s\" option
Welcome to the control layout editor!
Let\'s take a quick look at how to use it.
This is the control layout editor\'s floating menu button
Drag it to reposition it! Tap it to open the editor menu and the control layer list
This is the control layer list
A control layer works like a graphics layer: it is a container that holds controls. You can organize the controls you add by placing them on separate layers
Every control layer you add will be listed here
Tap this button to create a new control layer
Once a control layer is selected, you can add any type of control to it
Want to change how your controls look?
You can create appearances for your controls so they can be quickly reused and switched between
You can also add your favorite styles to the shared style cabinet!
The style cabinet is global: no matter which control layout you are editing, the styles inside are always there~
From here, you can add the favorited styles to the current control layout for use~
Use the preview mode to test out your control layout
Once you\'re done editing, remember to save your control layout!
Tap any blank area to continue to the next step
Tap any blank area to finish the guide
Every direction of the joystick can be set up with its own trigger events
The joystick has 8 directions that can be triggered
When you push the joystick into the matching area, the events bound to that direction will be triggered
There is a detection area right above the joystick: while pushing the joystick, slide your finger into that area to trigger \"Forward Lock\"
\"Forward Lock\" can be toggled in \"Joystick Config\", where you can also adjust the distance of this trigger area
As long as your finger enters the lockable area, the joystick will trigger \"Lock Events\"; it has no effect when \"Forward Lock\" is off
Tap the button to edit its trigger events
The triggerable events are the same as those of regular buttons, so you have plenty of freedom here
If you only want to control the game, just edit the actual key bindings in the \"Key\" section
